name: Blue hour
summary: A finished house at blue hour, the sky just after sunset, and the only warm colour on the page is the house's own light. The hero is the house edge to edge with an engraved wall keypad: Evening, Cinema and Away change the photograph. Below, every light numbered on a photograph with its reason, the house in 3D full width on Signature (it lights up room by room), rooms lit at night, a warm full-width photograph, the services as the chart inside a fuse board's door with the registers beside it, and the fault guide. Blueberry blue ground, pale green-white flesh text, the bloom on the skin as the one colour (the lit key, the chosen light, one phrase per heading). Encode Sans Expanded (hairline headings, engraved capitals) and Encode Sans. Square controls throughout. For premium electricians, lighting designers and smart-home installers.
